leftEvidence.title: Jesus compares lilies with Solomon’s glory

points.label: Solomon-relative action
points.left: Jesus points to lilies clothed by God and says Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of them.
points.right: Jesus refuses a demanded sign except Jonah’s and says the queen of the south will judge the generation because she came to hear Solomon’s wisdom.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Anxious hearers are directed from royal splendor to ordinary creation and divine care.
points.right: Solomon’s wisdom becomes a witness against those who resist a greater presence.

payload.posture: Jesus makes Solomon lesser than lilies clothed by God and lesser than the one present before the sign-seeking generation.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus speaks of one greater than Solomon

payload.tension: Royal glory and wisdom remain memorable precisely as subordinate comparison points.
payload.title: Splendor surpassed and wisdom surpassed
